cases.baseline_prompt_en: A natural photographic costume portrait of a fictional model, explicitly an adult woman, wearing a complete historical uniform ensemble in an intricately staged single scene. Use the supplied portrait as the face and bob-hair reference, retaining the soft oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, delicate nose, natural lips, and dark chin-length bob with wispy center-parted fringe. She stands in a quiet station baggage hall beside a low wooden costume trunk, just finishing a small adjustment at her waist. Her Zouave costume consists of a short open navy wool jacket with curved scarlet braid edging, a fitted navy waistcoat beneath it, a broad red woven sash wrapped around her waist, and very full scarlet trousers gathered toward the ankles. The jacket ends above the sash, the visible waistcoat sits within the jacket opening, and the sash separates the short upper layers from the ballooning trousers. White canvas gaiters enclose the lower trouser ends above dark leather shoes. A low red felt fez with a dark tassel rests above her visible bob. Her right fingertips tuck a short sash tail into the waist wrap while her left hand rests loosely at her side; both feet settle flat on the stone floor with a small gap between them. Long afternoon window light rakes across the wool nap, raised braid, sash folds, and cotton gaiters, with cooler hall light filling her face. The brass corners and pale tissue lining of the open trunk echo the warm light. She glances toward the camera with quiet confidence and a softly relaxed mouth. A full-length, nearly frontal frame includes her head, hands, waist, ankles, and shoes; the clothing junctions and generous trouser volume remain clearly readable against the subdued hall.
cases.interpreted_intent: The user requests an independent random complex reference-guided keyword rendering test. Agent-selected direction: Zouave historical costume layers worn by a fictional adult woman in a quiet station baggage hall, caught finishing a sash adjustment. The random names, station, colors, pose, adulthood, and wardrobe configuration are agent-authored choices in open dimensions, not user definitions or required typed assertions. The whole-frame appeal is quiet self-possession with subtle sensual presence from direct attention and soft mouth, ordinary reality, and readable wool/canvas/material relationships. A baggage-hall variant was chosen over a formal display because the small adjustment gives the ensemble an inhabited transition without busy staging. Reference scope is face and bob-hair appearance, not actual identity or age.

cases.baseline_prompt_en: A complex costume-photography concept set in a glass-enclosed hangar passage just after rain. The photograph shows an adult fictional woman, a model using the supplied reference, wearing a generic sage-green one-piece flight suit with a zipped center front, long sleeves, separate chest and thigh utility pockets, and a defined waist belt. Her face and short dark bob follow the supplied reference image: dark eyes, gently curved brows, wispy parted fringe, and the rounded jaw-length hair silhouette. The garment construction is visibly readable. Beside a waist-height brushed-metal service cart, her right thumb and index finger pinch a corner of folded white linen on the flat tray while her left hand rests on the near cart rim; both wrists connect visibly to her sleeves. Her weight rests evenly on two planted feet, and the long trouser legs end at ankle cuffs above plain dark boots. She glances toward the camera with quiet ease while finishing this small adjustment. Rain beads and a faint wet reflection remain on the glass behind her; a hangar door recedes in the background. Cool window light crosses the sage fabric from one side, while a small warm wall lamp gives a soft amber edge to the metal tray and her hair. The matte woven flight-suit fabric, crisp linen, brushed metal, and translucent wet glass have distinct surfaces. A front three-quarter full-length environmental portrait keeps the zipper, waist, pocket boundaries, both hands, and boots legible, with the face leading and the linen gesture reading second. The clothing is a generic fictional aviation costume.
cases.interpreted_intent: Requester asks independent complex random test concepts that use the supplied image and visibly realize enriched keywords. I independently sampled the flight-suit family, rainy glass passage, linen-adjustment micro-action, and cool/warm light combination. The chosen image is a generic aviation-costume editorial with an explicitly adult fictional model; face/hair use the reference, while clothing, place, action and camera staging are agent-owned open choices. Subtle ease and eye contact support sensual=1; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no treatment. The flight suit is ordinary apparel, with an intentionally calm material contrast between fabric, linen, metal and wet glass. A more ceremonial cabin-service scene was considered but rejected because the sampled family is a flight suit. This concept and all its specific geometry are agent-authored, not a requester definition or semantic assertion.

cases.baseline_prompt_en: A layered costume photograph shows a model guided by the attached portrait, portrayed as an adult fictional spacecraft technician. Her short dark bob, airy separated bangs, gently rounded face and large dark eyes follow the visual cues of the reference. She wears a plainly visible costume: a retro space workwear one-piece jumpsuit in matte ivory woven fabric, with a compact upright collar, a central front zipper, rust-orange shoulder and chest panels, two utility chest pockets, a narrow webbing waist belt with a small metal buckle, reinforced knee patches, pale work gloves and ankle-high utility boots. At the end of a maintenance shift she stands beside a waist-high service-door lever in an old orbital workshop, turning the lever through a small quarter turn with her right gloved hand. Her right elbow is softly bent and the lever is beside her right hip, clear of her torso; her left arm hangs relaxed and both boots rest on the grated floor. The turned lever sits in a diagonal position against its circular mounting plate. Behind her, ribbed wall panels and a partly open service hatch recede toward a round frosted observation window. Amber light from a caged work lamp grazes the zipper teeth and glove creases, while cool blue window light rims her bob and separates the matte cloth from a brushed-metal door. A full-length three-quarter front view keeps her face, the whole garment and the hand-to-lever contact readable, with the calm end-of-shift expression and tactile uniform as the visual center.
cases.interpreted_intent: The user asks for independent randomized complex scenes to test visible realization of newly reflected costume keywords and use the attached image. This arm independently selected retro space workwear with a seeded random draw. The particular adult fictional technician, end-of-shift workshop, lever action, garment cut and warm/cool material lighting are agent-owned choices within open dimensions, not user definitions. The photograph should convey a quiet practical presence and subtle human attraction through the relaxed bearing, reference-guided face and tactile workwear. The uniform remains the focal object of the keyword test.
